checkpoints.description: Task 'principle-roadmap-m5-budget' completed successfully.
P001 deep pass: Tier 1B regression, ungated 15.6k-token AGENTS.md, duplicated Tier 2, header contradicting R1/R3, capsule drift, stale counts

impact_assessment.why: Measured: shipped domain template blocks sync on all 5 targets (my milestone-5 regression); AGENTS.md is ~15.6k real tokens and auto-loaded by AGENTS.md-convention agents; AGENTS.md and GUIDELINES.md are two drifting hand-maintained copies
impact_assessment.benefits: Restores the advertised Tier 1B allowance; cuts always-on context for AGENTS.md-convention agents ~12x; one SSOT removes ~11k tokens of duplicate Tier 2 and all body drift
impact_assessment.risks: SSOT relocation touches sync tooling, tests, README and knowledge docs; capsule tightening could strip mechanisms (R2); budget renumbering could read as goalpost-moving
impact_assessment.mitigation: Structural cuts before semantic ones; mechanism-preservation tests; red-green test that the shipped template syncs under budget; full suite + dogfood after each milestone; micro-commit each milestone

checkpoints.description: Milestone 2/3: GUIDELINES.md becomes the single Tier 2 SSOT; AGENTS.md becomes a generated, budgeted Tier 1 target

impact_assessment.why: AGENTS.md is ~15.6k real tokens and auto-loaded by AGENTS.md-convention agents (Codex, Copilot coding agent); AGENTS.md and GUIDELINES.md are two hand-maintained copies with title-only parity and ~6 one-sided rules
impact_assessment.benefits: Cuts always-on context for AGENTS.md-convention agents ~13x; removes ~11.5k tokens of duplicate Tier 2; one body of rules can no longer drift from itself
impact_assessment.risks: Adopters on the old layout could have a hand-authored AGENTS.md overwritten by sync; SSOT relocation touches sync tooling, tests and docs
impact_assessment.mitigation: Sync refuses to overwrite any target still containing principle schema, with a migration message; strict schema validation aborts before any write on an unmigrated GUIDELINES.md; reconcile one-sided rules before deleting either copy

impact_assessment.why: Two defects this pass (7 stale '18' counts, P019 absent from both checklists) came from expansion-time drift that no test caught

impact_assessment.risks: Count regex could false-positive on unrelated numbers
